notes.title: Car Dealership Simulator 2 – Development Update & Release Date
notes.content: [p][/p][h3][b]Hello everyone![/b] [/h3][p]During this intense development period, we’ve added a lot of new content to the game, expanded the map with new areas, and made the overall experience smoother, more enjoyable, and more satisfying. The long-awaited moment has finally arrived: Our game will be released on [b]September 26, 2025![/b][/p][p] [/p][p]We put great care into every vehicle in our game, working hard to perfect both the visual details and the driving dynamics. [/p][p][/p][p]Even after release, we will continue to update our game regularly with new cars, improved mechanics, and content shaped not only by our roadmap but also by player feedback.[/p][p] [/p][p]We are confident that the vehicles and gameplay will advance far beyond their current state, offering a richer experience with each passing day.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Gameplay Trailer is live![/b][/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="vp8RJt316pI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]Don’t forget to like and comment on our game trailer! You can also share your thoughts with us.[/b] [/p][p][/p][h3][b]New in-game screenshots![/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/6e38cdde4ce87af60604fdca82534df851e6325b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/461c20c6985765f170934d737ef5d34434d2badf.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/820da538bd9de64ce073124319a7e96ef4412b4c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/31a47a9b60d56de2993843f44e089e2f22f1844b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/74fecf101c38ea7fdc47976be14c75148c048cec.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/1a0c763ebe4fd9d0a0802afe3bc9e9b90baa70b3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/ba854ae4db1a68bbfcf5a373834b12f11f6a1c02.jpg"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3616550/Car_Dealership_Simulator_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]Support the development of our game and join us on this journey — by sharing your ideas, comments, and feedback, we can take the game even further together! [/b][/p][p][b]Thank you for your support.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Car Dealership Simulator 2 Devlog Update
notes.content: [p][/p][h3][b]Hello everyone![/b][/h3][p][b]It’s great to reconnect with you after a long break. We’ve been working hard on the game throughout the development process. During this time, we’ve added new content, expanded the map, and significantly improved the overall experience. Every detail is being carefully refined to deliver the best possible experience for our players. The release date is getting closer every day, and we’re incredibly excited, we can’t wait to share it with you very soon![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/b68060deb98cea6d4e1125f10f7ad901279cb980.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/ac5801025da8cb3d86f30c68282067bea095d42b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/992378e04d1a537e11a8edb391469b25323d23ae.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/ba854ae4db1a68bbfcf5a373834b12f11f6a1c02.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/2eaf05b3f352bf72a1904f922a7269b20961e67a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Car Dealership Simulator 2: New Features and Updates
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/0b95cc3a4df2db262c3ac2c73af6cb595850c571.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/d5469f6f883493da167a95552ba0c477f2c0869f.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Hello everyone!👋[/b][/h3][p][b]We’ve prepared this update to walk you through some exciting game mechanics and notable features, giving you a clear picture of how the game works and what it has to offer. Enjoy reading![/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Steam Next Fest 📢💥[/b][/h3][p][b]⚠️"Our game is currently featured in Steam Next Fest! You can download the limited demo, try it out, and share any bugs or content suggestions you'd like to see added during development. Your support means a lot to us!"⚠️[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/3b662a01f18726f709c8bff3cdaf08ecf01bf270.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/ce79f0c4ff2c8c81c349781461d84dd9520dd984.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/d544c0c15117f4a4777d41921a00401e70ece7e8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Used car markets and dealerships will be located in specific areas on the map. Vehicles will be sold at dealerships by class, while used car markets offer affordable options for buying and selling. This lets you choose between new and used vehicles.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/a6033dd0efb207d68b66a7be3ccd29c219c72050.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Vehicles are classified into super sports, luxury, mid-range, and lower segment classes. Each class has its own dealerships, and some vehicles are also sold in used car markets according to these classes.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/682a22d22fc0ecb5c660b5e258d0f00765e64b63.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/43cb3df91b4cd656fdd5e8deaef486d6cf1524fb.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/60fff5b44f727031329a39bcbc706a219cafb5ba.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Vehicles have basic features like acceleration and weight, plus unique details. Sports and luxury cars’ brake discs can heat up, while super sports cars have animated spoilers at high speeds. Interiors are detailed and realistic.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/93a218610331db67dce7cab5fd7a335a27cd1d6c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Customize your cars with visual mods like rims and paint to reflect your personal style.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/befce03c236efd3ab1a5fdac3ed81b01b8503755.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/f99a7fd59eba86c517820d2c7c52310d2a117be9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/ef01a8c3d70b22fb0ca9e7502bc46487c05b7eef.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]The game will feature NPCs in specific areas who give missions and can be interacted with. These characters offer tasks based on their content. In future updates, we plan to expand this system with voice acting and more detailed dialogues.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/ee961dde8b31d90073ea4a5dd24679d3deaa51b8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/848155b42f97fd0360e9f1c2c272520ec77e6e82.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/4a12268436fb509d207b3ad469985948539f7530.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/1ba8381c8a55e52d52b19866c92aaeaf92091659.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/9711bae0ba790fd62c4b6e953ec5a8451905682b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]The game will feature not only vehicles but also purchasable car sales shops, houses, and various properties. These assets allow players to expand their in-game investments and living spaces.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][u]⭐As development continues, we’ll keep sharing updates about the new content added to the game. After the demo, we’ll announce many of the new features we’ve been working on in upcoming posts.‼️[/u][/b][/p][h3][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/ba854ae4db1a68bbfcf5a373834b12f11f6a1c02.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3616550/Car_Dealership_Simulator_2/"][/dynamiclink][b]Don’t forget to add Car Dealership Simulator 2 to your wishlist and follow us to stay updated on all the latest developments![/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/2eaf05b3f352bf72a1904f922a7269b20961e67a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]⬇️ If you’d like to check out our other games.[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2625620/Storage_Dealer_Simulator/?curator_clanid=38756390"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2141690/Car_Dealership_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
